thesis: A late-session dip-rebound rule remains profitable after 1.5-times modeled costs and above 100 historical trades across a compact return-threshold and range-position neighborhood.
rationale: A bounded event-engine diagnostic on training and validation only found two adjacent configurations with 103 and 107 trades, positive 1.5x-cost returns in both phases, and phase profit factors between 1.53 and 1.74. This nine-point immutable neighborhood varies only the two thresholds separating those configurations before final-test access.
